sources.quote: IRS has provided little assurance that the data it disclosed on the Section 527 Web site are timely, complete and correct.
sources.searcher_note: Old general finding that IRS doesn't vet the 527 notice data it publishes; says nothing about businesses filing notices or the 2022-2025 window

notes: Nothing found on businesses filing Form 8871 political-organization notices, a jump after Dec 2022, look-alike companies, or the July 8, 2025 batch. Searches turned up only IRS instructions, scam-PAC coverage (political groups, not businesses), ProPublica's 527 Explorer launch (2024-06-18, fetched; no data-quality finding) and old GAO/TIGTA oversight reports. The GAO 2002 line is the only general data-quality finding recorded; it may not count as a pattern.
